name: openpixo/item-icon-set
title: Item icon set
description: A matching set of inventory icons generated on one sheet, sliced into single icons and resized to a fixed size.

description_i18n.en: A matching set of inventory icons generated on one sheet, sliced into single icons and resized to a fixed size.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在一张图上生成风格统一的道具图标，切成单张并缩放到固定尺寸。

inputs.name: items
inputs.label: Items, in order (comma separated)

label_i18n.zh-CN: 物品（按顺序，用逗号分隔）

inputs.placeholder: iron sword, wooden shield, red health potion, brass key

placeholder_i18n.zh-CN: 铁剑，木盾，红色生命药水，黄铜钥匙

label_i18n.zh-CN: 美术风格（留空则跟随游戏）
图标组名称（文件夹名，小写）

recipe.prompt: A game inventory icon set on a strict {{grid}} grid (columns x rows) of equal square cells, one item per cell, with no gaps, no visible grid lines and no slot frames. Items in reading order, left to right then top to bottom: {{items}}. Leave a cell empty if the list is shorter than the grid. Each item is centered in its cell, fills about 80 percent of it, and never touches or crosses the cell edge. All icons share one style, one light direction from the top left, one outline weight and the same slight three-quarter angle, so they read as a single set. Bold readable silhouettes and strong value contrast that stay clear at small sizes. Style: {{style}}. Background: fully transparent, with nothing behind the subject: no floor, cast shadow, scenery or vignette.
recipe.negative: text, letters, numbers, labels, captions, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame, grid lines, gradient background, background scenery, floor shadow, photograph, blurry, jpeg artifacts, cropped, cut off at the edge, duplicated parts, deformed anatomy, extra limbs, slot backgrounds, rarity borders, overlapping icons, items spanning two cells, inconsistent styles, tiny details that vanish at small size, hands holding items
